name: sample_material_req_doc
script:
docname = frappe.form_dict.get("docname")
action = frappe.form_dict.get("action")

doc = frappe.get_doc("Material Request", docname)

if action == "approve":
    doc.custom_approval_status = "Approved"
    doc.workflow_state = "Approved"

elif action == "reject":
    doc.custom_approval_status = "Rejected"
    doc.workflow_state = "Rejected"

else:
    doc.workflow_state = "Pending"

    frappe.throw("Invalid action.")

doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.commit()

frappe.response["message"] = f"Material Request {docname} has been {action}d."

name: Dhanush
script:
import frappe

# 🔹 1. CREATE a new ToDo document
new_todo = frappe.get_doc({
    "doctype": "ToDo",
    "description": "This ToDo was created via server script",
    "status": "Open",
    "assigned_by": frappe.session.user
})
new_todo.insert()
frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Created: {new_todo.name}")

# 🔹 2. READ the same ToDo document
fetched_todo = frappe.get_doc("ToDo", new_todo.name)
frappe.msgprint(f"📖 Read: {fetched_todo.name} → {fetched_todo.description}")

# 🔹 3. UPDATE the status of the ToDo document
fetched_todo.status = "Closed"
fetched_todo.save()
frappe.msgprint(f"✏️ Updated: {fetched_todo.name} → Status set to Closed")

# 🔹 4. DELETE the ToDo document
frappe.delete_doc("ToDo", fetched_todo.name)
frappe.msgprint(f"🗑️ Deleted: {fetched_todo.name}")
